summary: An on/off switch for a setting, with its label, description and error beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps external <label for> from naming the inner input. Does not change with the state.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when other visible text names the switch.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid and sets a customError validity.

value.note: Submitted with the form while on; nothing is submitted while off.

checked.note: On or off. Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: must be on to submit. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not submitted. A disabled fieldset ancestor disables it too without changing this attribute.

size.note: Track 32x20px (default) or 24x16px (sm); the label row keeps its text size.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: track in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: The pill track; positions the thumb over the native input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">, covering the track; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Round knob; at the inline start when off, the inline end when on. aria-hidden.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl). FormData read in the listener already has the new value.

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring around the track in ring color (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with primary and the thumb moves to the inline end; position, not color alone, shows the state. The thumb slides with switch.transition-*; under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce it moves without transition.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated mixin (ElementInternals): formValue() is value while on, null while off; formReset() restores the checked attribute default; formStateRestore() restores checked; validationAnchor() is the inner input (required -> valueMissing, error -> customError). isDisabled covers a disabled fieldset and is not submitted. <label for> on the host clicks the inner input.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20px (sm 24x16px); the label next to it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color around the track.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009). Does not toggle.

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox; its checked state is exposed as aria-checked true/false natively
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
thumb is aria-hidden; no mixed state
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)
state change is announced by the screen reader as on/off from the switch role

useCases.when: A single setting that is either on or off, such as enabling notifications or airplane mode
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label naming the setting

useCases.when: The consequence of turning the setting on needs explaining
The setting must be on before the form can be sent
useCases.use: required, with a label that states what is being turned on

useCases.when: A dense list of settings, such as a table row or a compact panel

antiPatterns.pattern: A label that changes with the state ("On" / "Off", "Enabled" / "Disabled")
antiPatterns.why: The switch role already announces on or off; a changing name confuses screen-reader users (WAI-ARIA APG switch pattern)
antiPatterns.alternative: A fixed label naming the setting

antiPatterns.why: A switch has only on and off; the switch role has no mixed value

antiPatterns.pattern: Picking several items from a list, or agreeing to terms
antiPatterns.why: Those record a choice rather than turn a setting on; this system uses a checkbox for them (Checkbox contract)

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing exactly one option from several
antiPatterns.why: A switch is one independent on/off value

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Label and Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn uses a button with role=switch (Radix); the native input gives form validity, Space and label activation for free
a button-based switch toggles on Enter; native checkbox behavior and SB-0009 are kept, consistent with Checkbox
shadcn's default input color is far below 3:1; changed for WCAG 1.4.11

drift.contract: default 32x20 / sm 24x16 track, thumb = height - 2 x inset
drift.realization: shadcn default track is 32x18.4 with a 16px thumb; rounded to the 4px grid through size.switch.*

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: APG switch pattern for role and keyboard, the visual reference for look and sizes (differences in realizations.web.drift), Checkbox for the label row and form behavior.

openQuestions.question: Native input type=checkbox with role=switch, or a button with role=switch and aria-checked?
openQuestions.answer: Native input with role=switch (recommended). It brings native validity (required -> valueMissing), Space, label activation and the NativeControl mixin shared with Checkbox; a button would re-implement all of them.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle the switch (APG lists it as optional) or submit the form?
openQuestions.answer: Enter submits the form (recommended), like the native control, Checkbox and SB-0009. Space is the toggle key.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: No (recommended). The attribute is the default that form reset restores, like Checkbox and native defaultChecked.

openQuestions.question: Is label required?
openQuestions.answer: Yes (recommended), like Checkbox and Input. hide-label keeps it as the accessible name.

openQuestions.question: Which two sizes, and what are they called?
openQuestions.answer: default and sm (recommended), the reference names, aliased to medium and small in spec/api.json; track sizes from the existing size.switch.* semantic tokens.

openQuestions.question: Label after the track only, or also a label-first / space-between layout for settings lists?
openQuestions.answer: Label after the track only (recommended), like Checkbox. Other layouts are not requested; revisit when a settings-list kit needs one.

openQuestions.question: Icons or on/off text inside the thumb or track?
openQuestions.answer: No (recommended). Not in the visual reference; thumb position already shows the state without color.

openQuestions.question: Who runs the manual screen-reader pass (VoiceOver, NVDA) for the switch role?
openQuestions.answer: The a11y-checker skill's a11y-auditor brief at the beta review (recommended), before status moves past beta.
